Squash-merge rewrites history: hashes recorded in mined data (fix-log, enriched commits) stop resolving after PR merge. Any tool that git-blames/diffs a stored hash must guard with git rev-parse --verify --quiet first (blame-linker fixed). Error signature: fatal bad revision in last-error.log.

Health scores must age out fixed failures: last-error.log blocks and smoke-report.json counted forever, so grades never recovered after root-cause fixes. system-health now scores only 14d-recent failures and marks gate reports >14d as stale; memory-trimmer rotates error blocks >30d to archive.

Freshness heal cmds must WRITE the file they freshen: sentinel-eval rule ran sentinel --quick which never wrote eval.json, so the heal was a no-op for 119d. Fixed with tools/sentinel-eval-bridge.cjs. When adding a freshness rule, verify the refreshCmd actually touches rule.file.
